product.description: SERIA „DINASTIA DUCILOR“ Sheridan Wolfe, duce de Armitage, și frații lui vitregi sunt hotărâți să rezolve misterul care planează asupra morților suspecte ale celor trei soți ai mamei lor. Când i se dă sarcina de a cerceta un posibil suspect, Sheridan se trezește periculos de aproape de frumoasa fiică a acestuia, Vanessa Pryde. Bântuit de amintirea unei iubiri tragice, ducele nu vrea să se lase pradă atracției și manevrelor căutătoarelor de soți cu titluri nobiliare. Oricum, minunata domnișoară Pryde pare îndrăgostită lulea de un dramaturg londonez… Vanessa e de părere că o manevră mică, pe ici, pe colo, nu strică, mai ales că ea pe Sheridan îl vrea, lui i-a dăruit inima. Afacerea cu dramaturgul este doar de fațadă, ca să-l determine pe ducele cel scump la vorbă să se deschidă. Și cum Sheridan își arată repede gelozia, cei doi se găsesc curând implicați într-o cu totul altă schemă, condimentată cu o logodnă falsă, o anchetă secretă și, de ce nu, o poveste de dragoste adevărată…   Sabrina Jeffries este autoare a peste 40 de romane, vândute în aproape 10 milioane de exemplare și traduse în 20 de limbi.

# A Duke Under Cover by Litera (The Dynasty of Dukes Series)

Step into a captivating world of mystery, passion, and aristocratic intrigue with *A Duke Under Cover*. This thrilling novel, part of the popular "Dynasty of Dukes" series, promises an irresistible blend of historical romance and suspense.

## Discover the Mystery and Romance

The story centers around Sheridan Wolfe, the Duke of Armitage, and his brothers. They are faced with a perplexing mystery surrounding the suspicious deaths of their mother's three husbands. As they dedicate themselves to investigating potential suspects, Sheridan finds himself drawn into the orbit of Vanessa Pryde, the beautiful daughter of one of the implicated men.

Bothered by memories of tragic love and the allure of noble titles, the Duke grapples with his intense attraction to Vanessa. He struggles to resist the charms and schemes of society's title-seekers.

Vanessa, however, is not merely a pawn in these games. She appears captivated by a London playwright, but her true motives are more complex. For her, a small maneuverâa push here and thereâis nothing. She has given her heart to Sheridan, despite the danger. Their entanglement deepens when she realizes his attachment to the playwright is just a facade meant to prompt the wealthy Duke to open up.

As Sheridanâs jealousy becomes evident, the two are swiftly pulled into an even more elaborate scheme involving a fake engagement, a secret investigation, and, inevitably, a true love story unlike any other. This page features *A Duke Under Cover*, a must-read for fans of sweeping historical romance mysteries.

## About the Author & Series

*A Duke Under Cover* is part of the highly successful "Dynasty of Dukes" series. The novel is penned by Sabrina Jeffries, an acclaimed author known for her prolific writing career. She has authored over 40 novels, selling nearly 10 million copies and translating her work into 20 languages worldwide.
